data.name: label4.Text
data.value: Choose "Nessie" if you prefer performance, or "PartialNES" if you prefer accuracy. [!] Nessie is currently "experimental", and can often crash or fail to run [!] PartialNES is marked for deprecation in 2.0.0, and will no longer be available after.

data.name: label12.Text
data.value: Here, you can change the app's language. Currently, localisation is extremely limited, so do not expect many strings to be translated.

data.name: label13.Text
data.value: Controls marked with [X] are features which do not currently exist, but are planned for the future. Controls marked with [/] are only compatible with specific cores.

data.name: label7.Text
data.value: Not all NESes are identical. For that reason, you might want to emulate a specific console variant if you want to run certain games. [i] Some specific hardware combinations may not exist for actual hardware, or may not be intended for standard NESes
